home.noPlans: Plans you write will wait here.

tool.coolEnd: That's the time. Stop whenever you like.

after.before: Before you start, if you like: how is it now?

tags.title: Tags

tags.bodyNote: Off until you switch it on.

settings.afterRow: Show the optional row after a tool
settings.title: Settings
settings.comfort: Shorter exhale, just go at your pace

safety.cold: Cold on the face can slow your heart rate. Skip it if you have a heart condition, take medication that affects heart rate, tend to faint, or have a skin condition on your face. Use cool water or a wrapped ice pack, never ice directly on skin, never hold your breath or submerge your head. If unsure, check with your GP. Stop if you feel dizzy or unwell.
safety.crisis: If you're in crisis or need someone now: Samaritans 116 123 (free, 24/7) · Pieta 1800 247 247 · Emergency 999 or 112

breathe.comfort: Shorter exhale, just go at your pace
breathe.settled: Po is settled. Stay as long as you like.

s1.title: Your Now cards
s1.intro: If you like, pick up to three for the Now screen. You choose once, at a time that suits you, so Now never needs a decision.
s1.limit: Three chosen. Untick one to swap.

s2.title: Quiet and handoff
s2.quietHint: The screen dims, Po sleeps and nothing is asked.
s2.handoffHint: It opens in your messaging app, where you choose who receives it. No contact is stored here.

s3.title: How Po looks
s3.intro: One option: check that Po is easy to see, then pick the look that suits you.

s4.title: Movement and sound
s4.intro: Both can be changed any time in Settings.

evidence-bank.intro: Things that went well, or that others have said about you. Add one whenever you like.

parking-lot.intro: Write a thought that isn't settled and put it here. It will wait.

appointment-prep.intro: Points to raise at your next session. They stay here until you remove them.

repair-note.intro: An optional note for another day.

plans.title: If-then plans
plans.intro: If this happens, then I could do that.

nameIt.intro: If you like, pick a word, or write your own. Nothing is saved.

pros.intro: Lay out both sides. Nothing here is saved.

stims.intro: Your own movements and textures that feel good.
examples: Rub a smooth stone or soft fabric

handoffTool.intro: This sends your message through your messaging app. You choose who receives it.

play.bubbles: Tap a bubble to pop it.
play.shapes: Tap the place each shape belongs.
play.kaleido: Watch the pattern turn. Tap for a new one.

export.title: Export
export.intro: Nothing leaves this device unless you choose to save or share a file.
export.notesCsv: Notes go into the CSV only if you choose them here.
export.jsonNote: A backup holds everything on this device, whatever the date range.
export.restoreIntro: Choose a backup file you saved earlier.
export.restoreNote: Restoring replaces what is on this device with the contents of the backup. If there is anything here you want to keep, save a backup first.
export.restoreBad: That file doesn't look like a Pocket Po backup. Nothing was changed.
export.restoreNewer: That backup comes from a newer version of Pocket Po. Nothing was changed.
export.restoreFailed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.
export.footer: This summary is self-collected by the user from an app on their phone. It only records times the app was opened, so it is a minimum count, not a full picture. Ratings and tags are optional and self-reported; the user's awareness of internal body signals may be reduced, so ratings may under- or over-state distress. These figures are descriptive only and are not evidence of any diagnosis.

report.secBlocks: Now-mode uses by time of day
report.earlyNote: Tools with at least 3 completed or early-exit sessions. Very quick exits and content screens are left out.
report.recoveryLine: Median minutes from a Now session to the next session with a lower "before" rating, within 3 hours:
report.recoveryOf: Found for {found} of {eligible} Now sessions with a rating.
report.recoveryCaveat: Low reliability: it depends on optional ratings and on when the app happened to be opened.
